title: Vehicle Eligibility Matrix for KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
A KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans level can be sold on a vehicle only within that level's limits on model age, odometer and fuel type at sale. The matrix sets out those limits together with the vehicle-related terms that are the same at every level.

## Matrix A — age, odometer and fuel type at sale

| Plan level | Maximum model age at sale (years) | Maximum odometer at sale (miles) | Gasoline | Hybrid | Diesel | Battery-electric |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | 12 | 120000 | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible | Not eligible |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | 12 | 120000 | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible | Not eligible |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 10 | 100000 | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | 10 | 100000 | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | 8 | 80000 | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 8 | 80000 | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Not eligible |

The age and odometer figures are maxima: a vehicle at exactly the maximum is within the limit, and a vehicle one year older or one mile higher is not.

## Matrix B — terms that are the same at every level

| Term | Every plan level |
|---|---|
| Vehicles in rideshare or delivery use | Not eligible |
| Calendar days after vehicle handover within which a plan can still be bought | 90 |
| Active plans a vehicle may carry | Only one |
| Plan may be transferred to a new owner | No |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical vehicles)

The vehicles below are examples only.

| Example vehicle at sale | Starter or Basic | Standard or Plus | Premier or Premier Max |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gasoline, model age 9 years, 85000 miles | Within limits | Within limits | Outside limits (age above 8, odometer above 80000) |
| Diesel, model age 6 years, 60000 miles | Outside limits (diesel not eligible) | Within limits | Within limits |
| Hybrid, model age 12 years, 120000 miles | Within limits (both at the maximum) | Outside limits (age above 10, odometer above 100000) | Outside limits |
| Battery-electric, any age or mileage | Outside limits | Outside limits | Outside limits |
| Gasoline, within every limit, used for deliveries | Outside limits | Outside limits | Outside limits |
